title: Western Wadden subtidal survey — macrozoobenthos 1981–82, 2008–10
description: NIOZ subtidal macrozoobenthos survey of the western Dutch Wadden Sea (Dekker; Dekker & Drent). 1981–82: Van Veen grab and flushing sampler (under-samples deep burrowers); 2008: 392 of the stations resampled with a box corer; 2009–10: 60 stations a year in natural mussel beds and culture plots. Biomass = afdw x mult / sampled surface, on the sampling date (the seasonal 'corfac' is not applied); failed samplings dropped. Carbon per ERSEM-BFM feeding group from AFDM x species energy content / 45.8 kJ/g C, split over groups with MARINETRAITS fuzzy scores; built with tools/prepare_benthos.py.
source: NIOZ Royal Netherlands Institute for Sea Research (R. Dekker, J. Drent)
